workflows.purpose: Answer a bounded question using authoritative evidence.
Investigate independent unknowns and synthesize source-backed findings.
Implement an approved behavior with observable acceptance and focused checks.
Reproduce an observed failure, establish its cause, fix it and verify the changed path.
Evaluate existing work against explicit criteria with concrete evidence.
Compare alternatives against constraints and obtain a decision before consequential execution.

topologies.solo: Use one agent for coupled reasoning, shared invariants or small work.
topologies.parallel: Use only for substantial independently checkable branches with explicit semantic interfaces and one integrator.
topologies.generator-evaluator: Separate generation and evaluation when consequential risk or demonstrated quality gaps justify the overhead.

inference: The host agent chooses from this descriptive catalog; it is not a keyword classifier or a universal performance ranking.
